verdict.rationale: The evidence describes llamafile bundling GGUF weights into a single executable and supporting the GGUF format, but nothing addresses whether an already-downloaded GGUF file (or llamafile's embedded weights) can be reused by other runtimes' caches without re-downloading or re-converting. Missing for 10: any documentation or community report on extracting/sharing model weights across llamafile, Ollama, llama.cpp, or similar caches without duplication or reconversion.
